summary: Standardize action-based offers and currency presentation

delivery.outcome: The experimental SaaS lifecycle standard represents generic usage-priced subscriptions, capability-equivalent allowance tiers, verified expiring PrePaid add-ons, localized multi-currency presentation and separate self-hosted perpetual licensing without making seats, actions, browsers or payment adapters implicit authorities.
nonGoals: Define the meaning or metering algorithm of a product-specific action
Choose plan prices, settlement currencies or exchange-rate sources
Calculate VAT, refunds or jurisdiction-specific consumer rights
Process payments, publish offers or deploy customer workloads
Store credentials, raw payment payloads or tenant coordinates

architecture.decision: Keep one closed provider-neutral document family. Plans declare a commercial kind, deployment mode and optional generic usage allowance. Capability parity is asserted by an offer-scoped group and validated by exact entitlement equality. A prepaid add-on has one-time settlement, never-reset allowance, explicit validity and compatible base plans; buying it issues a server-verified usage grant without replacing currentPlanRef. Display quotes become explicit base/quote pairs, and locale defaults require direct quote coverage unless the requested display currency already equals settlement. Perpetual self-hosted items use one-time settlement and may expose optional recurring maintenance while remaining outside Cloud usage renewal.
dataChanges: Extend the experimental wellmanifest.saas-offer/v1, request, state and receipt shapes before stable release
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket-002 implementation and validation commits; ticket-001 remains the integrated v1 baseline.
